scope: Offline preparation review only; no numerical authorization

findings.title: Preserve completed samples when later work fails
findings.detail: costs, micros and generated_code returned local arrays only on success. Later checksum/owner/exception failures discarded prior samples; qualification discarded partial records. In-memory retention alone also loses evidence on watchdog termination.

findings.title: Bound guard housekeeping by the inclusive deadline
findings.detail: Unbounded subprocess.run waited for guard cleanup and full pin hashing beyond the inner 84-second child timer. The observed 90-second rejection was not an external execution bound.

findings.title: Apply per-process cost gates before the second launch
findings.detail: Stage validation checked raw schema but deferred required per-process allocation and timing budgets until aggregate after process2, allowing an already-disqualified first process to continue the sequence.

findings.title: Capture predicate code growth separately
findings.detail: Only the 256-call batch IR was captured. No probe-body IR/size evidence supported the planned bounded predicate-local code-growth review.

followup_notes: The first supervisor correction relied on a concurrently reaped child leader while signaling numeric groups. The revised implementation snapshots each member, uses pidfd plus repeated identity reads and checks current owner identity.
A follow-up required fresh PGID OR session membership after the second member read; same_identity deliberately excludes membership. Final mock coverage includes member_left_session.
The optional no-scope predicate bypassed normal record! journaling. The diagnostic copy now journals its already-computed record; reconciliation orders it between the first20 and last5 transitions.
Raw sample retention now includes an append-only flushed journal outside timers. It is not an fsync/power-loss guarantee, and incomplete tails remain rejected evidence.
bindings_scope: Preserved initial draft and intermediate supervisor evidence only; corrected current sources await final admission review
